title: Special Civil Maintenance and Repairs to North Point Lighthouse Station buildings & Allied facilities, North Bay.
summary: Online percentage-rate e-tender for special civil maintenance and repairs to the buildings and allied facilities of North Point Lighthouse Station, North Bay, Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)

sites.name: North Point Lighthouse Station, North Bay, A & N Islands
sites.work: Special civil maintenance and repairs to station buildings and allied facilities

scope.item: Special Civil Maintenance and Repairs to North Point Lighthouse Station buildings & Allied facilities

money.notes: Cost of bid document free. EMD by Deposit at call Receipt/FDR/DD or bank guarantee in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram; valid 6 months from technical bid opening; originals with technical documents by 23.06.2025 15:00. MSME/NSIC registered bidders for similar work eligible for EMD exemption.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Experienced civil contractors with successfully completed similar work of construction/maintenance of buildings in Andaman & Nicobar Islands with Government organizations, without adverse remarks
Detailed eligibility as per Section-III clause 3.1 of tender document (not included in this file)
Bidders whose near relatives are accountants/gazetted officers in DGLL not permitted
notes: Document is Section I (NIT) only: pages 1-3 Hindi, pages 4-6 English version with identical values. No BOQ or Section III eligibility details included. Two bid system; bid download/submission 06.06.2025 18:00 to 23.06.2025 15:00; technical bid opening 24.06.2025 15:00 subject to internet availability.
